LanguageData.Boudhisme.label: Buddhism
LanguageData.Boudhisme.description: Buddhism is a religion and a philosophy whose origins are in India in the sixth and fifth centuries BC. AD following the awakening of Siddhartha Gautama in Bodhgaya and the dissemination of his teaching.
LanguageData.Christianisme.label: Christianity
LanguageData.Christianisme.description: Christianity is one of the main religions of the world. Monotheistic, since it professes faith in a single god, it is based on the acts and words of Jesus.
LanguageData.Coran.label: Islam
LanguageData.Coran.description: The Quran is the sacred text of Islam. For Muslims, it repeats verbatim the word of God (Allah). For Muslims, the Quran consists of the words of Allah, revelations transmitted by the archangel Gabriel to the last prophet and messenger of God, Muhammad, from 610–612 until his death in 632.
LanguageData.Judaisme.label: Judaism
LanguageData.Judaisme.description: Judaism is the first of the three great monotheistic religions to have professed faith in a single God, who revealed himself for the first time to the Hebrew patriarch Abraham. It is the religion of the Jews, as well as the theology, law and cultural traditions of the Jewish people.
LanguageData.klan.label: Klan
LanguageData.klan.description: Precepts followed by members of the Ku klux Klan, whose foundations are slavery and racism.
LanguageData.Geopol_Structure_OriginCommunism.label: Communism
LanguageData.Geopol_Structure_OriginCommunism.descrip: Communism is a far-left ideology aimed at the abolition of social classes and private property so that everything belongs to the community.
